title: Summary
text: This session had two goals: close out the StrudelAI MVP report (the previous context window ran out mid-execution of the /report skill, leaving manifest.json and chunks.jsonl unwritten) and verify that the AgentWiki compile pipeline could ingest the new report cleanly. Both were accomplished — but the compile revealed a latent bug that would have blocked every future uv run agentwiki compile invocation. The bug was in compiler/search.py: the guard that drops the LanceDB nodes table before recreating it used 'nodes' in db.list_tables(), but db.list_tables() returns a ListTablesResult object (not a plain list), so the in check always evaluated to False — the table was never dropped, and create_table raised ValueError: Table 'nodes' already exists on every run after the first. The fix extracts .tables from the result object before the membership test, making the pipeline idempotent. With the pipeline fixed, 6 nodes compiled and the StrudelAI MVP report is now live in the AgentWiki knowledge graph. Session memory was updated to reflect the completed MVP so future conversations start with accurate project state.

title: Changes
text: Files changed: compiler/search.py — fixed db.list_tables() check by extracting .tables attribute from ListTablesResult before in membership test; compile now idempotent. strudel-ai/reports/2026-05-18-strudel-ai-mvp-complete/manifest.json — created AgentWiki manifest for StrudelAI MVP report with 13 entities and 13 link edges. strudel-ai/reports/2026-05-18-strudel-ai-mvp-complete/chunks.jsonl — created 5 search chunks for StrudelAI MVP report. memory/project_strudel_ai.md — rewritten from 'not started' to full MVP-complete state with architecture, key files, dev commands, and v0.2 roadmap. memory/MEMORY.md — updated StrudelAI index line to reflect MVP completion.

title: Affected Code
text: build_search_index(nodes, output_dir) in compiler/search.py — the drop-before-recreate guard now correctly resolves ListTablesResult to list[str] before membership test; previously crashed on every compile after the first. manifest.json and chunks.jsonl for StrudelAI MVP consumed by AgentWiki compiler to build graph edges and search index. memory/project_strudel_ai.md rewritten; future sessions load accurate MVP state instead of stale 'not started' status.

title: Evidence
text: uv run agentwiki compile (post-fix): 6 node(s) compiled — dist/nodes/ + dist/index.json + dist/similar.json + dist/lance/ + dist/neighbors.json + dist/graph_stats.json + dist/kuzu/. LanceDB idempotency: compile runs twice in succession without error. StrudelAI 30/30 tests: carried forward from prior session, all pass, production build clean. manifest.json schema: all required fields present. Memory update: project_strudel_ai.md reflects MVP completion, MEMORY.md index updated.
